# CSS Showcase

> Live CSS demos with the code for each example. 37 demos across layout, forms, navigation, feedback, overlays, data display, and utilities. Mobile-first with light and dark themes.

Official URL: https://css.techhive.net/

## Browse

- [Home and flagship device-switcher demo](https://css.techhive.net/): a skeleton app that reshapes between desktop, iPad, and mobile with container queries, aspect-ratio, and custom properties.
- [All demos](https://css.techhive.net/demos): every demo grouped by category.
- [Reusable components](https://css.techhive.net/components): the shared component gallery.

## Updates

- [Changelog](https://css.techhive.net/changelog): release history in plain language.
- [RSS feed](https://css.techhive.net/changelog/rss): subscribe to release updates.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ajbatac/css-showcase): open source. Clone it, run it locally, or send a pull request.

## Notes

- The site sets no cookies and runs no trackers. The only stored preference is the light/dark theme choice in local storage.
- Forms, logins, and uploads shown in demos are visual examples only; nothing is submitted anywhere.
